entities.name: Jori Lehterä
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jori Jonatan Lehterä is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a centre for HIFK of the Liiga. He was selected by the St. Louis Blues in the third round, 65th overall, of the 2008 NHL entry draft. He won a bronze medal with Finland at the 2014 Winter Olympics.
